correctness.rationale: For the eight vertices of Q3 and the ordinary cut complex (facets complements of disconnected k-sets), independent exhaustive enumeration found exactly 32 disconnected 4-sets with even/odd profile (1,12,6,12,1), and exactly 8 disconnected 5-sets. The Δ4 simplicial f-vector is (8,28,56,32) with complete 2-skeleton; exact rational simplicial boundary ranks are (7,21,32). Independently computed a full 32×32 ∂3 minor determinant −1, proving a primitive image and no integral H2 torsion; thus reduced H2=Z³ and all other reduced homology zero. Complete two-skeleton ⇒ simply connected; Hurewicz and homological Whitehead imply Δ4≃∨³ S². The Δ5 facets exactly equal the four triangles on each parity tetrad, hence S²⊔S². Both parity full tetrahedra are 3-simplices of Δ4, so both component inclusions bound 3-balls, proving the actual filtration inclusion is nullhomotopic. This is exhaustive eight-vertex verification, not a general higher-cube proof.

value.rationale: The eight-vertex 3-cube is a canonical smallest higher-dimensional Cartesian cube. Determining consecutive upper levels exactly, including two disconnected parity-sphere components mapping nullhomotopically into a connected wedge, provides a natural finite transition datum for graph cut-complex filtrations rather than a random tiny numerical output. The exact integral torsion check and inclusion map supply information missing from a mere Betti table.

limitations: Only the eight-vertex cube and adjacent k=4 and k=5 levels; no general higher-cube theorem.
Complete finite enumeration is exhaustive on this graph, not on infinitely many graphs.
